System Console.note: Established in existing bg.json ('Системна конзола > Дневници'). Lowercase 'системната конзола' in running text with definite article.

marketplace.note: User-facing strings use 'Пазар' / 'пазар на приложения'; several admin System Console strings keep English 'Marketplace'. Prefer 'пазар' for user-facing text.

thread.note: Established majority ('Разговор', 'непрочетени разговори'). A few strings use 'тема'; avoid the calque 'нишка'.

direct message.note: Majority rendering; a few strings use 'лично съобщение'. Keep 'директно съобщение' for consistency.

notification.note: Established. Plural: известия. A few older strings use 'уведомление' — prefer 'известие'.

pin.note: Verb; button 'Закачи', state 'Закачено' (established), unpin 'Откачи', pinned messages 'закачени съобщения'.

bookmark.note: Established in server strings ('отметки на канала'). Verb: 'добавяне на отметка'.

saved messages.note: Existing strings are inconsistent ('запазени публикации' vs 'запазени съобщения'); prefer 'запазени съобщения' to match message = съобщение. Save = 'запази', unsave = 'премахни от запазени'.

status.note: For user availability the majority uses 'състояние'; 'статус' appears in some billing/job strings. Prefer 'състояние'.

custom status.note: Existing strings mix 'персонализирано състояние' and 'потребителски статус'; prefer the former.

do not disturb.note: Mobile uses 'Не безпокой', webapp has 'Не безпокойте'. 'Не безпокой' is the majority; keep it as the status name.

guest.note: Plural: гости. Guest access = 'достъп за гости'.

sign in.note: Verb prose: 'влезте' (formal plural, per repo register). Button: 'Влез' or 'Вход'. Translate 'log in' identically.

mute.note: Channel-notification sense; button 'Заглуши' (established). Unmute a channel: 'Включи звука'.

unfollow.note: No existing bg string; button form 'Спри да следваш' per common Bulgarian social-app convention.

favorite.note: Sidebar category: 'Любими' (established). Verb: 'Добави в любими'; unfavorite: 'Премахни от любими'.

slash command.note: Existing strings are inconsistent: '/ команда' (frequent in webapp) vs 'команда с наклонена черта'. The latter reads better in running text; use it consistently.

webhook.note: Consistently kept in English in existing bg.json; inflected with a hyphen ('webhook-а') when a definite article is needed.

bot.note: Bot account = 'бот акаунт' (established in server strings).

seat.note: No existing bg rendering; 'място' alone works in licensing context ('10 места').

trial.note: Established: 'пробен период'; adjective form 'пробна' for the license label.

unread.note: Inflects: 'непрочетено' (neuter), 'непрочетени' (plural, used for the Unreads filter).

public channel.note: Majority; a few older strings use 'обществен канал' — prefer 'публичен'.

channel header.note: Existing strings mix 'заглавка' (webapp majority) and 'заглавие' (server); use 'заглавка' consistently.

channel purpose.note: Established majority; a couple of strings use 'предназначение'.

recap.note: No existing bg string; 'обобщение' is the natural term for an AI-generated activity summary.

burn-on-read.note: No existing bg string. Adjective usage: 'съобщение с изтриване след прочитане'; label form 'ИЗТРИВА СЕ СЛЕД ПРОЧИТАНЕ'.

magic link.note: No existing bg string; 'връзка' is the established word for link.

announcement banner.note: Established in webapp admin strings. 'банер за обявления' would avoid collision with message = съобщение, but keep the existing majority.

collapsed reply threads.note: No existing bg string; follows thread = 'разговор'. Feature name, capitalize as 'Свити разговори'.

compliance export.note: Established majority; some strings use 'износ на съответствие' — prefer 'експорт'.

access control.note: Established: 'Разширен контрол на достъпа'. Policy: 'политика за контрол на достъпа'.

onboarding.note: No existing bg string; 'въвеждане' (initial guided setup). Avoid transliterating 'онбординг' in UI text.

Town Square.note: Established default channel name in server bg.json.

Off-Topic.note: Established default channel name in server bg.json.
